Task.Name: Hold kickoff meeting with Student Union and food bank
Develop project charter and scope statement
Develop schedule, budget and risk register
Project plan approved
Task.Notes: Milestone: sponsor signs off the plan.

Task.Name: Design candidate routes and measure the 5 km course
Walk route with Campus Security and Facilities
Submit special-event and road-use permit application
City permit review (external)
Task.Notes: External wait: no team resource. The ELC follows up weekly.

Task.Name: Configure registration form, fees and waiver
Set up individual and team fundraising pages
Registration opens
Task.Notes: Milestone. Registration does not open until the route is approved.

Task.Name: Close registration and confirm participant list
Collect sponsor logos and recognition details
Develop marketing plan and key messages
Design posters, digital ads and social templates
Run social media and campus outreach campaign
Run residence and club team challenge
Task.Notes: Starts 5 days after the campaign launches (SS + 5d).

Task.Name: Final promotional push and race-week reminders
Build volunteer schedule and station assignments
Order T-shirts and medals (incl. supplier lead time)
Task.Notes: Mostly supplier lead time, so the ELC is assigned at 20%.

Task.Name: Book chip-timing service and race bibs
Arrange water stations, barriers, signage and first aid
Set up course and start/finish area
Run race, awards and sponsor recognition
Tear down course and clean up
Publish results and send thank-you messages
Reconcile funds and present donation to food bank
Run participant, volunteer and sponsor feedback survey
Write final report and lessons learned
